tasks.goal: Guide visitors from the Charter Hall entrance along the charter displays, gesturing toward each charter panel and stopping at the contribution model exhibit.
tasks.terrain: Smooth indoor plaza flooring around the Molecule Man exhibit; low display plinths and visitor crowds near the Spree boardwalk entrance.
success: Visits all 5 charter display waypoints in order
Speech utterance triggered at each waypoint
Path deviation < 0.3 m from planned route
safety_stops: Stop if a human is detected within 0.5 m
E-stop on tilt > 15 degrees
Abort tour if battery < 20%
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the tour script and confirms the charter text read aloud matches the posted charter.

tasks.goal: Walk the lab perimeter and inspect the molecule-model display pedestals, capturing RGB-D frames of each for the Evidence Monitor's records.
tasks.terrain: Riverbank-adjacent lab floor with cable runs, model pedestals, and occasional wet patches from Spree humidity near doorways.
success: All images in focus (sharpness score > threshold)
safety_stops: Stop on detected liquid on floor
Stop if pedestal contact detected
Return to dock if battery < 15%
tasks.human_in_loop: A researcher verifies the captured pedestal images before they are filed to the evidence log.

tasks.goal: Carry printed proposal drafts from the drafting desk to each debate table and return signed review slips to the collection tray.
tasks.terrain: Open forum floor with movable debate tables, chair clusters, and threshold ramps between the deck levels overlooking the Spree.
success: Return slip collected from each table
safety_stops: Stop if person within 1 m of path
Pause on stair or ramp edge detection
Release-and-halt on gripper fault
tasks.human_in_loop: Debaters sign the review slips; a steward decides which drafts advance — the robot never enacts proposals.

tasks.goal: Sort incoming task-routing cards into working-group trays on the Operations Deck console, using gentle grasping on the card fixture.
tasks.terrain: Fixed console table; tray dividers, glossy card surfaces, and cable clutter behind the work cell require precise grasp planning.
safety_stops: Stop on human hand in workspace
Reflex stop on joint torque anomaly
Halt if camera loses card detection for > 5 s
tasks.human_in_loop: An operator confirms tray assignments for any card the robot flags as ambiguous.

tasks.goal: Fly a slow scanning pass over the progress wall to capture overhead video of outcome trackers for the Progress Tracker agent.
tasks.terrain: Tall open atrium with the progress wall, hanging signage, and updrafts near the Spree-facing glass facade.
success: Covers 95% of wall area in footage
safety_stops: Land immediately if person enters airspace
Land on position estimate loss
Land if wind gust > 3 m/s detected
Return-to-launch on low battery
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the flight volume before launch and reviews the captured footage afterward.

tasks.goal: Haul equipment crates from the loading dock to the Research Synthesis Lab along the Spree boardwalk route beside the Molecule Man sculpture.
tasks.terrain: Gravel and paved Spree boardwalk with bollards, riverside drop-off edge, and pedestrian foot traffic around the sculpture plaza.
success: Reaches lab dock within 0.5 m accuracy
Average speed kept under 1.0 m/s in crowds
safety_stops: Stop if pedestrian within 2 m ahead
Stop on riverside edge-line detection
Halt on load-shift sensor trigger
E-stop on wheel slip > threshold
tasks.human_in_loop: A human supervisor teleoperates through the crowded sculpture plaza section and confirms final unload.

tasks.goal: Stand at the observatory entrance, greet visitors, and gesture toward the current progress metrics display using whole-body motion.
tasks.terrain: Level observatory floor with entrance mat transitions and a low plinth holding the metrics display; standing visitors within arm's reach.
success: Gesture points within 10 degrees of display center
Greeting speech intelligible in 95% of trials
safety_stops: Freeze upper body if visitor within 0.8 m
Sit-down protective stop on balance anomaly
Stop speech on operator mute command
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward reviews recorded greetings weekly and approves any change to the greeting script.
